name: mcp_call
instructions: You are preparing a Home Assistant MCP tool call.
Return ONLY JSON with fields: tool (string) and arguments (object).
Always include domain as an array (e.g., ["light"]). Include a specific name.
Do NOT set device_class unless confident it exists for the target domain.
For water use/usage/current water status questions, prefer a state-read tool from Tools when available, and pass entity_id when available (for example sensor.water_use).
